anchor.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: Fantasy tabletop RPG alternative house-style calibration anchor
Primary request: Create one square 2x2 visual reference board showing four separate handcrafted tabletop miniature dioramas in equal panels with narrow plain gutters and no labels. Top left: one adult medieval woman warrior standing at ease in a sparse village courtyard, full body visible with practical mail, worn leather armour, sheathed sword, round shield. Top right: one large adult brown bear standing naturally in a quiet forest clearing, whole body visible with four legs. Bottom left: one adult dragon standing calmly alert on rocky upland terrain, whole body visible with exactly one head, four legs, two fully framed wings, one tail, closed mouth. Bottom right: one small lived-in medieval village diorama with timber-and-stone houses, winding lane, well, fenced gardens, and modest watchtower, environment only.
Style/medium: Handcrafted painted-miniature diorama: clearly sculpted slightly exaggerated forms, matte hand-painted resin and plaster surfaces, simplified material textures, controlled edge wear and brush marks, deep but readable shapes, and a physically built scenic base. Photograph the miniature with neutral diffuse studio daylight and broad depth of field. No cinematic bokeh, no glossy CGI, no visible scale ruler or text.
Composition/framing: four clean equal square panels; each miniature and scenic base complete and safely inside its panel; one coherent sculptor, painter, scale, and photographic setup across all four
Lighting/mood: neutral diffuse studio daylight, calm and evenly readable; no theatrical spotlights
Color palette: natural local colors appropriate to each subject; no fixed dramatic palette
Constraints: same exact craft and rendering system in every panel; no human hands, display plinth labels, fire, magic effects, dramatic sky, rim light, text, logo, watermark, decorative border, or extra focal subjects

qa.notes: All panels share the same sculpting, matte paint, scenic-base construction, scale, and neutral photographic setup.
